description: A1 vocabulary: one observable learning goal through exact review assets; human rubric required.

input.idea: Teach the everyday English word 'umbrella' to worldwide non-native beginners (A1 planning level). After this lesson the learner can name the object and ask to borrow one when it rains. Use a clear picture of the object, simple English explanations and a short natural dialogue. Focus on this one word, not a list. Make exactly 4 slides. Use simple English-first teaching with visual explanation, no mandatory translation. End with one small practice action. CEFR labels are planning guides, not certification.
